fields.name: SessionTimeoutMs
fields.about: The coordinator considers the consumer dead if it receives no heartbeat after this timeout in milliseconds.

fields.name: RebalanceTimeoutMs
fields.about: The maximum time in milliseconds that the coordinator will wait for each member to rejoin when rebalancing the group.

fields.name: MemberId
fields.about: The member id assigned by the group coordinator.

fields.name: GroupInstanceId
fields.about: The unique identifier of the consumer instance provided by end user.

fields.name: ProtocolType
fields.about: The unique name the for class of protocols implemented by the group we want to join.

fields.name: Protocols
fields.about: The list of protocols that the member supports.

fields.name: Reason
fields.about: The reason why the member (re-)joins the group.
